name: Lennar (LEN)
teaser: Lennar reported $19.0 billion of earnings over fiscal 2021 to 2025 but generated $13.6 billion of operating cash. My Base is $84.81, 9.2% above $77.69, and the price already needs about 17.5% gross margin by 2031. Hold, with a maximum buy price of $50.89.
llms: Cyclical U.S. homebuilder with financial services, multifamily and technology investment segments, fiscal year ending November 30. Valued on the present value of returns on book equity above a 10% cost of equity through a five-year margin recovery (primary, 60%), cross-checked with an exit multiple on 2031 net earnings plus dividends and buybacks (40%); values are fair value today as of October 15, 2026. Main finding: net earnings were $19.0 billion over fiscal 2021 to 2025 but operating cash flow was $13.6 billion, and operating cash flow was negative $822 million in the first nine months of fiscal 2026 while $1.36 billion went to buybacks and dividends. The price needs a gross margin on home sales of about 17.5% by 2031, against 15.8% now. Bear $43.71, Base $84.81, Bull $120.66. Verdict HOLD at $77.69 (Confidence C, required margin of safety 40%), maximum buy price $50.89.
